processing: Transparent snapshots composited on opaque backdrop. Fixed integer head crops enlarged 2x nearest-neighbor. Whole model reduced to 480px with Lanczos. No sharpening or AI postprocessing.
normalPolicy: A source vertex NORMAL is retained. B has no NORMAL accessor and this absence is retained; no normals are added. Positions, indices, transforms and GLB binary chunks remain unchanged. Official converter obtains trimesh.vertex_normals when source normals are absent and sends them to the mesh renderer. Color and tangent normal textures removed in separate diagnostic GLBs.
limitation: This proves geometry appearance before B H3; it is not a completed B RGB or Box result.
